#{userId}

SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.tenant_id AS tenantId, CASE WHEN account.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS userEnabled, CASE WHEN d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS departmentEnabled, e.employee_no AS employeeNo, e.name AS employeeName, e.birth_date AS birthDate, e.dept_id AS deptId, e.position_id AS positionId, e.employee_status AS status, e.user_id AS userId, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.position_name AS positionName FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_user account ON account.user_id = e.user_id AND account.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id AND d.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id AND p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} LIMIT 1
